import os
import sys
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"


def main():
    # Define paths
    input_dir = "./input"
    submission_dir = "./submission"

    # Load Data
    train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
    test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
    sample_submission_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")

    if not os.path.exists(train_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Training file not found at {train_path}")
    if not os.path.exists(test_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Test file not found at {test_path}")
    if not os.path.exists(sample_submission_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Sample submission not found at {sample_submission_path}"
        )

    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

    # Ensure submission directory exists
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Identify columns from sample submission
    id_col = "Id"
    target_col = "Cover_Type"

    # Extract feature columns
    feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]
    feature_cols.sort()

    # Prepare Training Data
    # Convert numerical data to appropriate types, LGBM handles float32 well
    X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy().astype(np.float32)
    y_train_full = train_df[target_col].copy()
    X_train_id = train_df[id_col].copy()

    # Hold-out Validation Set (80/20 split) WITHOUT stratification to handle potential class imbalance safely
    X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_full,
        y_train_full,
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=42,
        stratify=None,
    )

    # LightGBM Parameters
    # Changed metric to "multiclass_logloss" to prevent "Multiclass objective and metrics don't match" error
    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": int(len(np.unique(y_train_full))),
        "metric": "multiclass_logloss",  # Correct metric for multiclass training
        "verbose": -1,  # Disable progress bar
        "seed": 42,
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.01,
        "feature_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
    }

    # Create LightGBM Datasets
    lgb_train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
    lgb_val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train_data)

    # Train Model (Early stopping callback disabled via callbacks list choice to force fixed rounds or use num_boost_round directly)
    # Note: Setting verbose=-1 ensures no output noise
    classifier = lgb.train(
        params,
        lgb_train_data,
        num_boost_round=500,
        valid_sets=[lgb_val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(0)],  # Disable log evaluation output completely
    )

    # Evaluate on Hold-Out Validation Set using Sklearn for Accuray Metric Calculation
    # The competition metric is Multi-Class Classification Accuracy, so we compute it externally
    y_val_pred = classifier.predict(X_val.astype(np.float32), raw_prediction=True)
    y_val_pred_class = np.argmax(y_val_pred, axis=1)
    val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred_class)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

    # Generate Predictions for Test Set
    X_test = test_df[[c for c in test_df.columns if c in feature_cols]].copy()
    X_test = X_test.astype(np.float32)

    y_test_pred_raw = classifier.predict(X_test, raw_prediction=True)
    y_test_pred_class = np.argmax(y_test_pred_raw, axis=1).astype(int)

    # Construct Submission File
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: y_test_pred_class}
    )

    # Ensure header matches template
    submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {os.path.join(submission_dir, 'submission.csv')}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
